decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this consent.
REASON
To comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.
The development hereby permitted shall not be carried out except in complete accordance with the details shown on the submitted plans, numbers:
TWC-183/LP-001 Rev B
TWC-183/SP-001 Rev B
SP-003 Rev K
GA-001 Rev A
GA-002-PH1 Rev C
GA-002-PH2 Rev B
BP-001 Rev D
BP-002 Rev C
RCA-002 Rev D
FL-001 Rev E
EV-002 Rev A
Balustrade Details (Adjustable Aluminium Channel) prepared by Pro-Railing
Door schedule prepared by Enfield Speciality Doors
Limewash product information prepared by Farrow & Ball dated 13.10.2025
and shall thereafter be retained/maintained for as long as the development remains in existence.
REASON
To ensure the development complies with the provisions Hillingdon Local Plan Parts 1 (2012) and 2 (2020) and the London Plan (2021).

The internal alterations hereby approved shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the approved plans. No deviation or variation shall take place without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority.
Reason
In order to safeguard the historic fabric and architectural interest of the listed building in accordance with Policy DMHB 2 of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 2 (2020).
All original doors removed as part of the development shall be stored within the boiler store, off the ground, and shall be clearly marked: "Original door - do not remove from site."
Photographic confirmation that the doors have been stored in accordance with these requirements shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority.
The doors shall be retained on the site and reinstated if the education use hereby permitted permanently ceases.
REASON
To retain original historic fabric and ensure that the alterations remain reversible, in accordance with Policy DMHB 2 of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 2 (2020).

Following completion of the internal strip-out works but prior to any cleaning, repair or sealing of the historic floor tiles within the main hall, full details of the proposed cleaning methodology, sealing of floor tiles in main hall shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The works shall thereafter be carried out strictly in accordance with the approved details.
Reason
To ensure appropriate conservation of historic floor finishes and to prevent irreversible damage, in accordance with Policy DMHB 2 of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 2 (2020).

Following completion of internal strip-out works but prior to the application of any new paint or decorative finishes, full details of the proposed internal hall colour scheme shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall thereafter be carried out strictly in accordance with the approved details.
Reason

To ensure that the proposed finishes preserve the historic character and architectural significance of the listed building, in accordance with Policy DMHB 2 of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 2 (2020).

The stained glass panels and the historic entrance gates shall be fully restored in accordance with the approved plans. The approved restoration works shall be completed prior to the opening of the school at the end of Phase 1.
Reason
To secure the timely restoration of key heritage features and to balance any associated harm arising from the development, in accordance with Policy DMHB 2 of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 2 (2020).

Before first occupation of the development, the entrance gates and associated gate pier shall be repaired and reinstated in accordance with details first submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
The details shall provide for:
- the right-hand entrance gate, when viewed from Wood End Green Road, shall be refurbished;
- the left-hand entrance gate shall be copied to match the right-hand gate;
- the pier shall match the existing pier, with the casting taken from the surviving historic metalwork; and
- the gates, pier and matching railings shall be finished in a heritage colour.
The approved works shall be completed before first occupation and retained thereafter.
REASON

To restore a significant historic feature within the setting of the listed building and preserve the character and appearance of Hayes Village Conservation Area, in accordance with Policies DMHB 1, DMHB 2 and DMHB 4 of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 2 (2020).

The fireplaces identified for restoration on the approved drawings shall be fully restored in accordance with the approved plans. The approved restoration works shall be completed prior to the installation of the roof on the new conservatory (Phase 2).
Reason
To ensure the reinstatement of significant historic features and to preserve the special interest of the listed building, in accordance with Policy DMHB 2 of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 2 (2020).

Prior to the commencement of construction of the conservatory foundations, joinery details and finishes of conservatory shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall thereafter be carried out strictly in accordance with the approved details.
Reason

To ensure that the conservatory is detailed and finished to an appropriate standard that preserves the character of the listed building, in accordance with Policy DMHB 2 of the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 2 (2020).

The decision to GRANT listed building consenthas been taken having regard to all relevant planning legislation, regulations, guidance, circulars and Council policies, including The Human Rights Act (1998) (HRA 1998) which makes it unlawful for the Council to act incompatibly with Convention rights, specifically Article 6 (right to a fair hearing); Article 8 (right to respect for private and family life); Article 1 of the First Protocol (protection of property) and Article 14 (prohibition of discrimination).

The decision to GRANT listed building consent has been taken having regard to the policies and proposals in the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 1 (2012) and Part 2 (2020) set out below, including Supplementary Planning Guidance, and to all relevant material considerations, including The London Plan - The Spatial Development Strategy for London consolidated with alterations since 2011 (2021) and national guidance.

On this decision notice policies from the Councils Local Plan: Part 1 - Strategic Policies appear first, then relevant Local Plan Part 2 (2020), then London Plan Policies (2021). Hillingdon's Full Council adopted the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part 1 - Strategic Policies on 8 November 2012 and the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 2 on 16 January 2020.

In dealing with the application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive way. We have made available detailed advice in the form of our statutory policies from Local Plan Part 1, Local Plan Part 2, Supplementary Planning Documents, Planning Briefs and other informal written guidance, as well as offering a full pre-application advice service, in order to ensure that the applicant has been given every opportunity to submit an application which is likely to be considered favourably.
description: Change of use from Class E(f) (children's centre) to Class F1(a) (education provision), together with associated external and internal alterations to the listed building. External alterations include limewashing of the building; installation of an external air source heat pump; replacement doors and a new French window door set; installation of an automatic opening vent within an existing rooflight opening; a new orangery and security building; installation of glazed balustrading and a gate at the foot of the stairs; refurbishment and reinstatement of entrance gates and associated posts; refurbishment of the existing pedestrian gate and posts; installation and refurbishment of security fencing; car park clearance and repainting; a new road layout and roundabout; landscaping; and cycle and refuse storage provision. Internal alterations include widened and new door openings; reconfiguration of toilet and teaching spaces; new safeguarding measures; upgrades to the sensory room; alterations to the teaching kitchen; and relocation of staff areas. (Application for listed building consent) (AMENDED DESCRIPTION)
